title: StrangeMatter.Recording.Video
description: A recording video asset. Classification distinguishes the source screen capture from a review output; PayloadDataType identifies the media format. Payload structure belongs to the producing app.

Extends.description: Include the EntityGUID of the series collection this recording component belongs to.

KomponentClassfication.description: Classify the representation and subject in the header so consumers can select this component without reading Payload.
